name: template_id
label: Design
help: The certificate design to issue from. Create and save designs at certera.ink.

name: recipient_name
label: Recipient name
help: The full name printed on the certificate (up to 120 characters).

name: institution_name
label: Issuer name
help: Leave empty to use the name in the design.

name: reference
label: Unique reference
help: For example an enrollment or order ID. The same reference never issues a second certificate, so a re-run is safe.
